pershkrimi: Fixture 1 of the answer key. Seven deliberate breaches, five clean clauses. Clause 6 is the false-positive trap: payment by the 10th of the following month LOOKS like a breach of Neni 116/1 but is expressly permitted because the parties agreed it in writing.
shenim: Ground truth read directly from kodi_punes_flagged.json, not from memory.

klauzolat.arsyeja: Job description, nothing constrained by law
Place of work and relocation inside the same qark, permitted
Indefinite contract with a start date, normal

shkeljet.pse: Probation set at 6 months. Neni 150/1 caps a written probation at tre muaj; Neni 142/1 treats the first 3 months as probation.
Notice during probation set at 3 days. Neni 142/3 requires at least 5 days, Neni 150/2 states 5 days.
50-hour normal week. Neni 83 caps the normal working week at jo me shume se 40 ore.
50 hours also passes the 48-hour ceiling in Neni 90/2.
Overtime declared with no annual cap. Neni 90/1 limits overtime to jo me shume se 200 ore ne vit.

klauzolat.arsyeja: TRAP. Neni 116/1 requires monthly pay at month end BUT expressly allows otherwise 'kur parashikohet ndryshe ne marreveshje me shkrim', and this clause is a written agreement. A system that flags this is producing a false positive.
klauzolat.shenim_vkm: Whether 85.000 leke clears the minimum wage CANNOT be judged from the Code. Neni 111/1 defers it to a VKM. Correct behaviour is to report it as unverifiable, never to guess.

shkeljet.pse: 10 days annual leave. Neni 92/2 sets a floor of jo me pak se 22 dite pune.
Flat 1-week notice regardless of tenure. Neni 143/1 requires 2 weeks up to 6 months, 1 month from 6 months to 2 years, 2 months from 2 to 5 years, 3 months beyond 5 years.
Non-compete of 3 years. Neni 29/1: afati i ndalimit nuk mund te jete me shume se nje vit.

klauzolat.arsyeja: Confidentiality, not constrained by the Kodi i Punes

te_paverifikueshme.arsyeja: paga minimale caktohet me VKM, jashte Kodit
